title: ProgramAlertViewDocument
description: Server-maintained live board alert, one document per alert: a staff attention send stamped for a duty (one per run and duty), or a cancelled or diverted flight or disrupted journey, merged with who took or finished it from programAlerts. Written by triggers on organizerMomentSends, programTravelLegs and programAlerts. A staff attention alert is readable by function leads holding that duty; a travel alert only by full reach (coordinators and the owner). The owner's account id is the only identity carried, so a phone can tell which alerts are its own. Never message recipients, contact details or mutation authority.

expiresAtMillis.description: A staff attention alert ends 24 hours after its send; a travel alert lasts while its journey is disrupted.

expiresAt.description: The same end as expiresAtMillis, as the timestamp the collection's TTL policy deletes on; null for travel alerts, which the trigger removes when the journey recovers.

duty.description: The duty a staff attention alert is stamped for; null for travel alerts.
